annotations.title: Do I need a visa? passport -> up to 25 destinations (or the full map)

description: Use when a traveller's nationality and destination(s) are known: visa-free / ETA / e-Visa / visa on arrival / visa required / no admission, max visa-free stay in days, what to do next and the official source. Omit destination for the passport's full map. Optional: passport, destination. PAID: $0.020 per call, no API key or account, or free with a Trip Desk Pass. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/visa.

destination.description: Destination country, or a comma-separated list of up to 25. Omit (with passport given) for the full map. Default (bare call): JP

pass.description: Optional Trip Desk Pass token (tp1....). With a valid pass this call is not charged. Prefer setting it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

passport.description: Passport country: ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 or English name. Default (bare call): US
